observations: Three photos show a large office printer wrapped in plastic, placed on a wooden shelf.
The printer has a black front panel with 'KONICA MINOLTA' and 'bizhub c3351' printed on it, visible in all three photos.
The top of the printer is beige, with a sticker that says 'THE ONLINE TRAINING FOR YOUR bizhub' and a QR code.
The printer appears to be in a storage or warehouse setting, surrounded by other wrapped items and cardboard boxes.
No power cord, paper tray, or toner cartridge is visible in any photo.
The printer is not shown in operation; no paper is being printed or fed.
The photos are watermarked with 'ECCENTRIC EQUIPMENT' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.evidence: The brand and model are clearly visible on the front panel in all three photos.
The photos show the printer's appearance, but there is no visual proof of color printing, A4 paper output, or all-in-one functionality. These features cannot be confirmed from the images alone.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Printer may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on, printing a test page, and feeding paper correctly.

risks.risk: Missing essential components (power cord, paper tray, toner cartridge)
risks.proof: Photos of the power cord, paper tray, and toner cartridge, or a video showing all components included.

risks.risk: Printer may be used or refurbished with hidden wear or damage
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the printer's interior, rollers, and paper path, or a video showing the printer in operation.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown condition

proof_requests: Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photos of the power cord, paper tray, and toner cartridge.
Close-up photos of the printer's interior and paper path.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
